name: 3M
description: 3M is a diversified materials-science manufacturer selling adhesives, abrasives, films, tapes, protective equipment, electronics materials and consumer products (Post-it, Scotch, Command, Scotch-Brite) in three segments: Safety and Industrial (46 percent of sales), Transportation and Electronics (33 percent) and Consumer (20 percent). It makes money by selling many thousands of products, mostly one-time sales to industrial, auto, electronics and retail customers (consumer goods through retailers), and it competes with specialised technology companies in each market. Since the April 2024 spin of Solventum (health care) it is mostly industrial. It completed its exit from PFAS manufacturing at the end of 2025 but still carries large PFAS litigation and remediation costs.

employees.note: About 60,500 full-time equivalents: about 22,500 in the US and 38,000 internationally. About 56 percent of 2025 revenue came from outside the US.

businessLines.name: Safety and Industrial
businessLines.how: Sells industrial abrasives, adhesives, tapes, electrical and personal-protection products (respirators, hearing, eye, fall protection), auto-body repair materials and roofing granules to industrial distributors, manufacturers and contractors; repeat consumable-style orders.

businessLines.name: Transportation and Electronics
businessLines.how: Sells films, adhesives, ceramics, reflective signage, graphic films, light-management and semiconductor and chip-packaging materials to auto makers, electronics and semiconductor manufacturers, aerospace and infrastructure customers; design-in contracts, then volume sales.

businessLines.name: Consumer
businessLines.how: Sells Scotch, Post-it, Command and Scotch-Brite branded home-cleaning, stationery, picture-hanging, air-quality and retail abrasives products through retailers and online; branded one-time purchases with seasonality (back-to-school, holiday).

brands.name: Post-it, Scotch, Scotch-Brite, Command, Nexcare, Cubitron
brands.note: Brands the 10-K lists as examples within its segments (Consumer: Scotch-Brite sponges, Post-it notes, Nexcare bandages, Command; Safety and Industrial: Cubitron abrasives, Scotch tapes); revenue by brand not disclosed

brands.name: Solventum (former health care business)
brands.note: Spun off April 2024; 3M retained an ownership interest in Solventum common stock, whose value changes run through other expense (income), net.
